We’re kicking off week two of early Black Friday Green Deals with a jam-packed edition, led by Yozma’s official event that is offering up to $935 savings, including the deal for the popular IN 10 Pro Electric Dirt Bike with a FREE $150 bundle at an exclusive new $1,614 low . Right behind that is Anker’s massive eufy Black Friday Sale with up to $1,100 security savings, like the new bundle for the eufyCam S4 4K Triple-Lens Bullet-PTZ Solar Security Camera 4-Cam Kit with the latest HomeBase Professional S1 hub down at $1,200 , and more top picks starting from $120. We also have EcoFlow’s latest 48-hour flash sale with up to $549 savings starting from $899 , tool deals on Worx’s Nitro 40V cordless snow shovel, Greenworks’ 80V cordless pole saw, and much more down below. As always on a Monday, you can find the best deals from last week rounded together in our latest Electrified Weekly recap edition here .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Yozma’s IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike bundle hits new exclusive $1,614 low for early Black Friday ($935 off), more from $949
Alongside the early e-bike and EV seasonal savings we’ve spotted, Yozma has also launched its Early Black Friday Sale event , complete with a spin-the-wheel opportunity for further savings. Of course, the biggest deal from Yozma is the IN 10 Pro Electric Dirt Bike down at $1,614.05 shipped (with 1-year extended warranty + FREE cycling bag ($150 value), after using our exclusive code Electrek at checkout. Down from $2,399, we previously saw the price go as low as $1,699 before this event with exclusive savings, but now, things are ramping up further for an even better price. All-in-all, you’re getting a combined $785 markdown ($935 total with bundled gear) with this deal, landing it at a new all-time low price that makes it the perfect opportunity to pick one up before Christmas rolls around. You can also find the standard IN 10 model down at $949.05 shipped , as well as the newest IN 11 Stunt-Ready Electric Dirt Bike at $1,424.05 shipped – both getting the same FREE $150 value bundle at those prices after using the above code.
You can learn about these electric dirt bikes’ features in our original sale coverage here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Anker’s Black Friday security sale cuts $700 off triple-lens solar 4-cam kit with up to 16TB HomeBase S1, much more
Anker has officially kicked off its eufy Black Friday Sale on security devices and robot cleaners , with up to $1,100 savings. On the security side of things, you can find options like the new bundle for the eufyCam S4 4K Triple-Lens Bullet-PTZ Solar Security Camera 4-Cam Kit with the latest HomeBase Professional S1 hub down at $1,199.99 shipped , after clipping the on-page $700 off coupon. This particular bundle isn’t available elsewhere yet, like on Amazon, but it does beat out the HomeBase 3 hub-included package by $200 . Down from a $1,900 full price, the deal saves you $700 while allowing you to step up your security with one of the brand’s most advanced systems to date, coming in $250 above the lowest price on the HomeBase 3 bundle (matched at Amazon ), which only occurred once during June’s Prime Day event. Considering the HomeBase S1 is a $500 model (with a more common $250 starting price these days at Amazon ), the deal here is quite the standout for the more advanced setup. Head below to check out top picks from this sale, or browse everything on the main page here .
Top picks from Anker’s eufy early Black Friday deals:

Indoor Cam S350 2-Pack: $200 (Reg. $280)
Video Doorbell E340 2-Pack: $200 (Reg. $340)
Essential Security Bundle: $255 (Reg. $400)

eufyCam S4 4K Triple-Lens Bullet-PTZ Solar 4-Cam kit: $1,200 (Reg. $1,900)
S4 Max 4K NVR 4-Cam Kit + 2TB HDD, Video Doorbell S4, and Chime: $1,400 (Reg. $1,850)
S4 Max 4K NVR 8-Cam Kit with 8TB HDD: $1,980 (Reg. $2,600)
And so much more…
EcoFlow offers up to $549 flash savings on four units, including 2x 1,024Wh DELTA 3 Classic stations at $899 ($299 off)
As part of EcoFlow’s continuing early Black Friday power station deals , the brand has launched another 48-hour flash sale increasing savings on four bundles – three of which give you double units with each purchase. One top option this time around is two DELTA 3 Classic Portable Power Stations down at $899 shipped , with the final $50 savings taken off in your cart, beating out Amazon by $25 , which has them at $462 for a single station (as opposed to the direct $479 rate ). This bundle is down from $1,198, which we’ve been seeing keep between $879 and $979 with discounts since late June following the month’s Prime Day event. While the last handful of months saw it taken down to $959 and $938 in flash sales, you’re instead getting a solid $299 markdown for extra savings, letting you split them between family members on trips or during emergencies. Head below to check out the full lineup of deals while they last.
***Note: Like always with EcoFlow’s flash sales, the actual flash pricing is finalized once the unit is placed in your cart, so don’t be caught off guard by slightly higher prices listed on the individual landing pages.
